newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MANUEL, STALS IN CAPE TOWN FOR "ROUTINE" TALKS.
newsitem.headline: MANUEL, STALS IN CAPE TOWN FOR "ROUTINE" TALKS.

text.p: Finance Minister Trevor Manuel, Reserve Bank governor Chris Stals and senior officials were scheduled to meet in Cape Town on Friday for a routine monthly consultation, a spokeswoman said.
Responding to market rumours of a special meeting to discuss exchange control liberalisation, spokeswoman Jennifer Wilson said: "It is not an extraordinary meeting."
She said Manuel, Stals and directors general Maria Ramos of finance and Hannes Smit of state expenditure met on the first Friday of every month for a financial planning meeting.
The meeting would take place in Cape Town because Stals was in the city for another engagement and Manuel was in Cape Town on parliamentary business.
Wilson said she did not know what was on the agenda for Friday's meeting.
